stem: The length, in centimetres, of a certain type of snake is modelled by the random variable $X$ with mean 52 and standard deviation 6.1. A random sample of 75 snakes is selected, and the sample mean, $\bar{X}$, is found.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Explain why it was necessary to use the Central Limit theorem in the solution to part **(i)**.
